prompt: TITLE: THE CONSUMER. A completely original monumental contemporary oil painting on raw linen canvas. A luxurious but time worn interior fills the entire composition - large muted walls, refined décor, soft natural light, an expensive Persian style carpet - overwhelmed by an enormous accumulation of rubbish: torn plastic bags, broken cardboard, crushed packaging, food remains, bottles, cans, old fabrics, broken furniture, scattered domestic waste. Rubbish painted as large painterly masses, not individual objects. In one corner, a solitary figure crouches low, body folded inward, mouth opened unnaturally wide, slowly consuming the rubbish directly from the floor - obsessive, not violent. Figure occupies a small portion; architecture and waste dominate. Face partially dissolved into paint; only mouth, hands, and eyes receive definition. Room remains strangely calm - no movement, no chaos, only silence. Soft daylight illuminates parts of the carpet, rubbish, and figure; large areas remain in shadow. Visible linen weave beneath thin paint layers. Dry broken brushwork, thin opaque passages, selective build up, soft scraping, natural gravity drips only where compositionally useful. Forms built through values, not outlines. No sculptural, plastic, or digital appearance. No frame, signature, watermark, or text. --chaos 5 --ar 4:5 --raw --profile 9xrlvtk cmsrmjg --stylize 80 --hd --v 8.1
